requirement.title: Rollback rehearsal
requirement.criterion: An approved rollback rehearsal must succeed on the target release and production configuration.

requirements.explanation: Two QA Lead rehearsal results are on record for the exact target (R2.4, b7a91f2, atlas-assistant, production). They contradict each other. RB-401 (TYN-103, 2026-11-08 11:00) says the restore succeeded with no data loss. RB-402 (TYN-174, second team, 2026-11-08 11:30) says the rehearsal FAILED because 214 session records were lost. Both authors are QA Leads, so the results are equally authoritative. Neither says it supersedes the other, and no later retest or resolution is recorded. Under the rules, contradictory current results with no resolution are inconclusive, and a later timestamp does not win by default. Neither record shows an approval of the rehearsal, although the criterion requires an approved rehearsal. The requirement's own comments (Done, "implementation complete") are developer claims and prove nothing. TYN-231 is a rollback run on a different commit (7ee67dd) in staging, so it is wrong scope. A recorded rehearsal failure on the target build is unresolved, so PASS is not supportable. I did not choose FAIL because the passing rehearsal is equally authoritative and the two records are not reconciled.
